notes:
Summary: SMB inbound, self-serve signup for hosted API. Primary goal: add lightweight conversational layer to their customer integrations console (support triage + intent routing) and use embeddings for internal doc search. Trial behavior: created account 2/18, got first key, ran quick POC scripts, then stopped. Team feedback: cost looked higher than expected for multi-turn chat; initial latency spikes hurt interactive feel. CTO (quoted on 2/24 demo): "We need ~200-300ms median for an integrated chat flow — anything above that feels sluggish to customers." Engineer (paraphrase): "token accounting was confusing in dashboard — thought we were on free tier then saw charges". Actionable obs: usage pattern shows many small requests (no batching) and repeated identical prefixes (opportunity for prefix/KV caching). They also tried competitor A's free tier (OpenAI) in parallel and saw slightly lower latency on short prompts — that's influencing switching.

POC notes / technical points:
- Workload: many short multi-turn chats (avg input 150-600 tokens), bursts during business hours (expected 6-8 qps initially).
- Targets: p50 <= 300ms, p95 <= 700ms; cost sensitivity: wants <$0.002 per conversational turn initially.
- Preferences: open to smaller quantized model variants if quality holds for FAQ/support; wants simple routing fallback to cheaper model.

What we've tried:
- Sent best-practice doc on batching + token controls (02/21).
- Walked through usage dashboard and token billing (03/01). AE clarified meter + free-credit expiry.

Current ask / friction:
- They want a quick replayable checklist to reduce token usage and an estimate of run-rate costs for 500-2,000 monthly sessions.
- Concern: team feels onboarding stalled because initial credit felt too small and billing surprised them; possible churn to competitor if we don't offer runway.

Suggested next steps (AE notes):
- Offer 30-day trial credit extension tied to POC milestones (Diego will propose cap and structure).
- Book 30m technical call to demonstrate caching + batching changes and show projected cost delta (target date next week).
- Provide example config for model routing and a conservative cost model for 1k sessions/month.

Sales cues: low ARR but high virality potential inside integration marketplaces. If we rescue this POC, potential expansion to paid tier in 3-6 months as integrations grow.
